mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 70 degrees. You can also look forward to an ISS flyover this evening starting at 5:46 PM, as it travels from the West over Mount Horeb toward the Northeast near Madison.

The city is hosting a public meeting on December 8 to discuss the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, including bridge replacements and future trail closures. Additionally, the Verona Police Department has compiled a summary of notable service calls handled between November 1 and November 15.

It is a busy week for entertainment with trivia happening today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look out for more live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and a mid-week trivia challenge at The Bogey Factory.
Regarding the police report, on November 6, officers were dispatched to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a woman passed out in her vehicle and subsequently arrested her for O W I.
You can enjoy today's Flavor of the Day, Caramel Turtle, at the Verona Culver's, which is currently open and serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
